name: Noosphere
detailed_description:
A child wakes up in a mysterious lab with no memory. He discovers that he has the ability to enter the minds of others, and decides to use this power to find the truth.

In Noosphere, a mystery-solving adventure game, you, as the protagonist, enter the minds of different themed characters to solve puzzles, collect clues, and make decisions that will have a profound impact on the child's future.

What truth is hidden between the child's past and the secrets of the institute? Travel between the real and the psychic worlds to collect all the pieces of the story and get closer to the truth. Good luck.

'Noosphere' is a game in which you play as a protagonist who can enter the minds of others to uncover the secrets of the institute by acquiring various clues. The game is a third-person, platformer exploration-based game where players can interact with characters, enter their minds, and investigate certain objects that are different from reality.

Collecting evidence from the real world and the mind

Travel between reality and the psyche to collect clues from various objects and environments.

The real world and the mental world may seem like the same place, but they have different structures and clues. Observing and comparing the differences between the two worlds is key to solving puzzles.

Multiple Endings and Branching Structures

Conversations with NPCs, investigations, and choices advance the story.

Depending on what you choose to say during conversations, characters will react differently and new information may be unlocked.

Thus, the player's choices directly affect the flow and ending of the game and create branching points.

Multiple endings exist, and replay allows for new developments and truths to be uncovered.

This game is currently in development, and a demo version is available before the main game is released.

You can experience the initial content and main systems through the demo, and your feedback will be a great help in future development.
